purpose: Authored fictional source-neutral review controls. These are not Goa legal advice, model outputs, runtime fixtures or changes to the frozen 71-case acceptance set.
review_basis: Minimum means all requested points and necessary linked qualifications, not shortness at the cost of coverage.

controls.question: Where should I report the blocked drain, and what documents must I attach?

evidence.text: The District Service Desk accepts blocked-drain complaints through its public form.
The drainage network was extended by 12 km during the pilot.

required_coverage: District Service Desk and public form, citing a
The supplied passages do not list required attachments; do not infer them
semantic_failure: Inventing identity photographs or a mandatory form number
Answering only where and silently dropping the attachment question

controls.question: What conditions govern beginning work on this wall?

evidence.text: The 2022 rules permit wall repairs only after Board consent. Structure details and design shall follow Appendix C. Scheduled structures are excluded from this permission.

required_coverage: Attribute the 2022 source with uncertain current applicability
Both structure details and design must follow Appendix C
Appendix C details and whether this wall is scheduled are not supplied
optional_to_omit: Unrelated local statistics or general planning procedures
semantic_failure: Dropping an obligation to make the answer shorter
Treating publication as verified current permission

controls.question: Does a national product certificate itself provide municipal construction permission?

evidence.text: The National Product Board certifies equipment. Construction permission for a proposed site is issued separately by the municipal planning office.
The Product Board issued 780 certificates in the 2023 reporting period.

required_coverage: Product certification and municipal construction permission are distinct functions
A product certificate alone does not establish the separately issued permission
semantic_failure: Adding the count without its reporting period
Expanding into an unsupported application procedure

controls.question: What benefit and limitation do these sources describe for the pilot barrier?

evidence.text: The 2021 pilot report observed reduced water-level fluctuations behind the barrier.
The same pilot report notes that the barrier restricted fish passage. It did not assess effects across the whole estuary.

required_coverage: Pilot evidence does not establish whole-estuary effects
semantic_failure: Retaining only the benefit for brevity
Converting a pilot observation into a universal claim

controls.question: What fee and filing deadline do the supplied sources give?

evidence.text: The undated service sheet lists a fee of 10 units.
A second undated sheet lists a fee of 20 units. Neither sheet is identified as superseding the other.

required_coverage: Report the conflicting supplied fees with attribution
The supplied evidence does not establish which fee currently applies
semantic_failure: Choosing one fee without a basis
Inventing a deadline or claiming the entire corpus has none
Refusing all useful information instead of explaining the conflict
